_comment: Preserved C-first setup miss, not entry-point evidence. Ctrl-V, ?, >, G reaches Vlad's Tower/tower1, and Ctrl-W changes the arrival terrain to a throne. However, tower1.lua puts a chest at the arrival square. sit.c:dosit checks the object pile before IS_THRONE, so #sit reports sitting on the chest and never reaches throne_sit_effect or special_throne_effect. The C artifact is retained in /tmp/B64-vlad-tower-chest-blocked-b64-c.session.json, outside recordings/.
